SfdcPartnerSbscrOffer.name: SfdcPartnerSbscrOffer
SfdcPartnerSbscrOffer.description: Represents a partner offer as seen by the customer in their subscriber org. Synced from Partner Business Org SfdcPartnerOffer record.

BillingFrequency.description: The frequency that a customer is billed. A hardcoded value copied from the PBO.

ContractTerm.description: Term duration of the contract. Max value of 12 months.

CustBillingAddress.description: The default billing address for the customer, used to seed the billing address into new offers. Compound field.

CustBillingGeocodeAccuracy.description: Accuracy level of geocoded billing address.

CustBillingLatitude.description: The latitude geo-coordinate for customer billing address.

CustBillingLongitude.description: The longitude geo-coordinate for customer billing address.

CustBillingPostalCode.description: The postal/zip code of the customer billing address.

CustBillingState.description: The state of the customer billing address.

CustBillingStreet.description: The street of the customer billing address.

CustShippingAddress.description: The default shipping address of the partner's customer. Compound field.

CustShippingCity.description: The city of the customer shipping address.

CustShippingCountry.description: The country of the customer shipping address.

CustShippingGeocodeAccuracy.description: Accuracy level of geocoded shipping address.

CustShippingLatitude.description: The latitude geo-coordinate for customer shipping address.

CustShippingLongitude.description: The longitude geo-coordinate for customer shipping address.

CustShippingPostalCode.description: The postal/zip code of the customer shipping address.

CustShippingState.description: The state of the customer shipping address.

CustShippingStreet.description: The street of the customer shipping address.

CustomerBillingEmailAddress.description: The email address used as the billing email address for the resulting order. Recieves the invoice and a copy of the offer. Typically, this person is in the finance department.

CustomerEmailAddress.description: Offer recipient who can approve or reject the offer.

CustomerName.description: The name of the customer company.

CustomerPaymentTerms.description: Indicates that the customer has 30 days from the invoice date to pay for services.

CustomerPurchaseOrderNumber.description: Customer provided purchase order number, which is added to an order upon offer acceptance.

ExpirationDate.description: The date the offer expires and the customer can't take further action.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate), but not viewed it.

Name.description: Required. Auto-generated offer number copied from the PBO.

OfferType.description: Type of order that is created once the customer accepts the offer.

OrderPrebillDays.description: Represents the number of days before the service date that an invoice is sent to the customer.

PartnerOffer.description: 18 character ID of the corresponding PartnerOffer record in the PBO.

PartnerOrg.description: 18 Character org ID where the offer originated. This field is automatically populated with the PBO ID.

PaymentMethod.description: The possible payment methods that customers can use to pay for their order.

RespondingUserId.description: The user ID in the Subscriber Org that corresponds to the user that accepted or rejected the offer.

ServiceEndDate.description: Derived field. The date when the contract terms end. Service end date is calculated as ServiceStartDate + ContractTerm in months.

ServiceStartDate.description: The date and time when the order is activated, if it is converted from an offer.

ServiceTerm.description: Period between Service Start date and Service End date.

SubTotal.description: Derived field. Formula summing all offer item line item totals and the contract term. Excludes taxes.

SyncToPboLastUpdate.description: Tracks the timestamp of the last operation performed by the sync operation.

SyncToPboStatus.description: Status of the sync operation to the customer org.

TermsAndConditions.description: The terms and conditions set forth by the partner.
